title: Dispatcher's Own Jobs
description: One dispatcher's scheduled export shouldn't be visible to another dispatcher poking around with a guessed job id — only admins get the bird's-eye view across everyone's jobs.
successCondition: Dispatcher A calls POST /api/reporting/jobs to create a job, capturing its id. Dispatcher B (a distinct dispatcher account) calls GET /api/reporting/jobs/:id with that id and receives 403 with error.code FORBIDDEN. An admin account calling GET /api/reporting/jobs/:id with the same id succeeds with 200.
hints: canSeeAll is derived purely from role === "admin" in the route handler — dispatcher is never treated as "can see all" even though dispatcher and admin share equal access elsewhere in the API (like billing/booking listings).
Register two distinct dispatcher accounts to get non-overlapping requestedById values to test with.
